I won’t make any changes yet.

What I would change exactly
- Remove (delete) slides 12 and 13 from the specified slide deck (the two slides that contain the unreleased roadmap). After removal, all subsequent slides will renumber (e.g., old slide 14 becomes 12).
- I will not edit content on any other slides or change speaker notes unless you ask.

What could go wrong
- Any internal links, animations, or references to those slides (or to their old slide numbers) may break or become incorrect.
- Presenter notes or export/PDF copies may still reference the removed slides.
- Whether the deletion is reversible depends on where the deck is stored: if it has version history (e.g., Google Slides/Drive) you can typically restore a prior version; if not, deletion may be permanent.

Can this be undone
- Possibly—if the storage system provides version history or if you want me to first copy the deck or move the two slides into a backup file, we can preserve recoverability. If you instruct permanent deletion and the system has no versioning, it may be irreversible.

Please confirm the exact scope before I proceed
1) Confirm the exact deck (name or link) you want edited.
2) Confirm the exact operation: permanently delete slides 12 and 13, or remove them but move them into a backup file (I can create a copy named “[deck name] — removed slides 12-13”) or just hide them?
3) Do you want me to also update any table-of-contents slide or linked references, or leave those for you?  

Reply with the deck identifier and which of the three deletion options you prefer; I will then proceed.
